tasks.brief: Use LAUNCH_GUILD_ISLANDS.md; reuse existing plot/placement/visit/theme modules. Maintain free start, safe routes, ownership on moves and cancellation. Existing commerce stays disabled; no new receipt implementation in this task.

tasks.title: Guild warfare and territory design-to-test package
tasks.brief: Retain latest full-game goal instead of silently dropping wars. Specify bounded match/objective/resolution states and test seams, then hand off explicitly owned runtime modules. No city PvP or economy mutations from cosmetic outcomes. Not certified as implemented from this package.

Include title, menu, hero, quest, skill tree, inventory, maps, shops, guild and exchange. Shop work is presentation-only through existing bindings. New commerce processing and live activation remain outside this work package.

tasks.title: Logo, crest and visual language
tasks.brief: Generate original brand and frame family through available approved tools. Preview/procedural outputs are not accepted final art.

tasks.title: Skill, item, quest and navigation icon production
tasks.brief: Bind real data IDs. Generate small consistent batches, crop/atlas with padding, verify actual UI size. Preserve canonical existing icons when valid.

tasks.title: Modular appearance runtime integration
tasks.brief: Adapt existing appearance services rather than forcing a new path. Changes outside assigned prefix require ownership handoff. Validate clothes, skin and identity persistence.

tasks.title: Elf, Orc, Dwarf and Wizard appearance
tasks.brief: Expand verified pipeline to all approved presets. Keep Wizard human; incompatible clothes are honestly marked unsupported until fitted.

tasks.brief: Read LATEST_GOALS.md. Reuse Content.ProgressionRulesets, HallLevelCap, RecruitmentStartingXP and StatusPoints. Novice Class2 readiness is35; retain legacy policy and earned paths. Do not switch default campaign flags or create a competing progression service. Additional migration/cutover requires its own tested fixture plan.

tasks.brief: Reuse current combat boundary. Improve readability and AI role behavior, validate representative existing probes and difficult lifecycle cases.

tasks.brief: Create or refine real skeletal clips with markers. Include five classes, movement blending, hit/down/recover states; no fake animation IDs.

tasks.title: Skill effects, impacts and enemy telegraphs
tasks.brief: Integrate actual game timing. Use approved images or labeled procedural flipbooks; pool and bound effects, preserve critical cues in every quality level.

tasks.title: City, guild zone and adventure-map quality
tasks.brief: Improve existing modular world. Validated plaza/tavern/guild/market/tower/portal routes and private building zones come before decorative expansion.

tasks.title: Monster and boss encounters
tasks.brief: Audit current content before filling approved gaps. Deliver distinct behavior with animation/VFX/audio hooks and lifecycle/reward tests; counts are targets, not permission for shallow copies.

tasks.title: Main, side, secret, world and class quests
tasks.brief: Integrate approved progression-v2 storyline with current quest IDs. Design checkpointed arcs and dependency tests. No market/pay/random recruitment requirement for mandatory progression. Audit actual Chapter00-06 services and current quest IDs before mapping the240 design entries. The normalized content_graph validator is an authoring check, not a full Luau parser.

tasks.title: Hero relationship quests and tavern identity
tasks.brief: Map actual hero templates to personal stories and unlock contracts. Hero level milestones refer to the hero; preserve actor ownership and skip/replay without reward duplication.

tasks.title: Gathering, crafting, equipment and inventory
tasks.brief: Reuse current item definitions and equip service. Audit meaningful resource loops and recipes; prepare binding changes under verified module ownership.

tasks.title: Market integrity regression and presentation contract
tasks.brief: Audit current escrow/epoch/mailbox and UI snapshots; do not change Phase4.5 ledger without isolated explicit task. No live cloud calls for this local audit.

tasks.title: Player guild and shared-base foundations
tasks.brief: Implement missing approved cooperative loop or improve existing one. Personal Hall remains separate. Validate invites/roles/leadership/plot ownership before treasury or war.

tasks.title: Combat, interface and world sound
tasks.brief: Generate only via available approved providers or use owned assets. Provide cue manifests and original/licensed audio; missing provider remains blocked.

tasks.title: Thai/English and accessibility acceptance
tasks.brief: Review all new screens and longest copy, labels, keyboard focus, safe areas, reduced motion, non-color-only cues. Coordinate real localization file ownership before writes.

tasks.title: Representative performance and cleanup pass

tasks.title: Private platform cross-server acceptance
